Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The new Super Hero selected by the Phoenix Force has joined MARVEL Future Fight!
In this additional patch, meet the new Super Hero Echo and her new Artifact.

 

Check out the new Super Hero by downloading the 2/15 patch.

 

■  2/15 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 2/16 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0) / 2/15 (Tue) 19:00 (PST)

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
   and the actual completion time will be updated once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
   When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service

 

[ 2/16 (Wed) 2:52 (UTC+0) / 2/15 (Tue) 18:52 (PST) added]

The patch has been completed as of 2/16 (Wed) 2:47 (UTC+0) / 2/15 (Tue) 18:47 (PST). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

▣ New Character Echo


Echo, once known for her connections to Kingpin and Daredevil,
has joined the world of MARVEL Future Fight with the power of the Phoenix Force!
 
Check out her abilities before you meet the new host of the Phoenix Force!
 

 

▣  New Artifact

 

A new Artifact has been added for Echo.

 

 

* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held in celebration of the new Super Hero: Echo

 

Thank you.
